<div class="tip" id="tip" role="status" hidden></div>
<!--DATA-->
<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const J = id => JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);
const EV = J("data-evidence"), CO = J("data-cohort"), SP = J("data-openspec"), LD = J("data-ladder"),
      FR = J("data-frontier"), NZ = J("data-noise"), CS = J("data-cases");
const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
const MINUS = "−";
function sgn(v, d){ if(v===null||v===undefined||!isFinite(v)) return "n/a"; const s=Math.abs(v).toFixed(d===undefined?3:d); return (v<0 && +s!==0 ? MINUS : "+")+s; }
function num(v, d){ if(v===null||v===undefined||!isFinite(v)) return "n/a"; const s=Math.abs(v).toFixed(d===undefined?3:d); return (v<0 && +s!==0 ? MINUS : "")+s; }
function ci(a, d, signed){ const f = signed===false ? num : sgn; return "["+f(a[0],d)+", "+f(a[1],d)+"]"; }
function el(tag, attrs, parent){ const e=document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for(const k in (attrs||{})) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if(parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }
function h(tag, attrs, html){ const e=document.createElement(tag); for(const k in (attrs||{})) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if(html!==undefined) e.innerHTML=html; return e; }
function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c])); }

/* ---------- text measurement ---------- */
const meas = el("svg", {width:"0", height:"0", style:"position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0", "aria-hidden":"true"}, document.body);
function tw(str, size, weight){ const t=el("text", {"font-size":size, "font-weight":weight||400, "font-family":getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily}, meas); t.textContent=str; const w=t.getComputedTextLength(); meas.removeChild(t); return w; }

/* ---------- chart tooltip ---------- */
const tip = document.getElementById("tip");
function showTip(target, html){
  tip.innerHTML = html; tip.hidden = false;
  const r = target.getBoundingClientRect(); const tr = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = r.left + r.width/2 - tr.width/2; x = Math.max(8, Math.min(x, window.innerWidth - tr.width - 8));
  let y = r.top - tr.height - 8; if (y < 8) y = r.bottom + 8;
  tip.style.left = x+"px"; tip.style.top = y+"px";
}
function hideTip(){ tip.hidden = true; }
function bindMark(g, html){
  g.setAttribute("tabindex","0"); g.setAttribute("class", (g.getAttribute("class")||"")+" mark");
  g.setAttribute("role","img"); g.setAttribute("aria-label", html.replace(/<[^>]+>/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim());
  g.addEventListener("mouseenter", ()=>showTip(g, html));
  g.addEventListener("focus", ()=>showTip(g, html));
  g.addEventListener("click", ()=>showTip(g, html));
  g.addEventListener("mouseleave", hideTip);
  g.addEventListener("blur", hideTip);
}
document.addEventListener("keydown", e=>{ if(e.key==="Escape") hideTip(); });
window.addEventListener("scroll", hideTip, {passive:true});

/* ---------- axis helpers ---------- */
function niceTicks(lo, hi, n){
  const span = hi-lo; const step0 = span/Math.max(1,n); const mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(step0)));
  const err = step0/mag; const step = (err>=7.5?10:err>=3.5?5:err>=1.5?2:1)*mag;
  const out=[]; for(let v=Math.ceil(lo/step-1e-9)*step; v<=hi+1e-9; v+=step) out.push(+v.toFixed(10)); return {ticks:out, step:step};
}
function tickFmt(v, step){ const d = step>=1?0:Math.min(3, Math.ceil(-Math.log10(step)-1e-9)); return num(v, d); }

/* ---------- forest plot ---------- */
function drawForest(box, rows, o){
  box.innerHTML = "";
  const W = Math.max(300, box.clientWidth);
  const fs = 13, rowH = 34, top = 10;
  const showVals = W >= 560;
  let lw = 0; rows.forEach(r=>{ lw = Math.max(lw, tw(r.label, fs, r.kind==="pool"?600:400), r.sub? tw(r.sub, 11):0); });
  const left = Math.ceil(lw) + 14;
  let vw = 0; if(showVals) rows.forEach(r=>{ vw = Math.max(vw, tw(r.val, 12)); });
  const right = showVals ? Math.ceil(vw) + 16 : 10;
  const pw = W - left - right;
  let lo = Math.min(0, ...rows.map(r=>r.lo)), hi = Math.max(0, ...rows.map(r=>r.hi));
  rows.forEach(r=>{ if(r.band){ lo=Math.min(lo,r.band[0]); hi=Math.max(hi,r.band[1]); } });
  const pad = (hi-lo)*0.06; lo -= pad; hi += pad;
  const tk = niceTicks(lo, hi, Math.max(3, Math.floor(pw/80)));
  lo = Math.min(lo, tk.ticks[0]); hi = Math.max(hi, tk.ticks[tk.ticks.length-1]);
  const x = v => left + (v-lo)/(hi-lo)*pw;
  const H = top + rows.length*rowH + 58;
  const svg = el("svg", {viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`, width:W, height:H, role:"group", "aria-label":o.aria}, box);
  const gy = top + rows.length*rowH;
  tk.ticks.forEach(t=>{ el("line",{x1:x(t),x2:x(t),y1:top,y2:gy,stroke:"var(--grid)"},svg);
    const tt=el("text",{x:x(t),y:gy+17,"font-size":12,"text-anchor":"middle"},svg); tt.textContent=tickFmt(t,tk.step); });
  el("line",{x1:left,x2:left+pw,y1:gy,y2:gy,stroke:"var(--line)"},svg);
  const xt = el("text",{x:left+pw/2,y:gy+44,"font-size":13,"text-anchor":"middle","font-weight":600},svg); xt.textContent=o.xlabel;
  el("line",{x1:x(0),x2:x(0),y1:top-4,y2:gy,stroke:"var(--ink2)","stroke-dasharray":"4 3","stroke-width":1.2},svg);
  if(o.refLine!==undefined && o.refLine!==null) el("line",{x1:x(o.refLine),x2:x(o.refLine),y1:top-4,y2:gy,stroke:"var(--ink)","stroke-dasharray":"1.5 3","stroke-width":1.4},svg);
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const cy = top + i*rowH + rowH/2;
    const g = el("g",{},svg);
    el("rect",{class:"hit",x:2,y:cy-rowH/2+2,width:W-4,height:rowH-4,rx:5,fill:"transparent",stroke:"none"},g);
    if(r.sep) el("line",{x1:0,x2:W,y1:cy-rowH/2,y2:cy-rowH/2,stroke:"var(--line)","stroke-dasharray":"3 3"},svg);
    if(r.band) el("rect",{x:x(r.band[0]),y:cy-9,width:x(r.band[1])-x(r.band[0]),height:18,fill:"var(--base-soft)",stroke:"#d5d8dc"},g);
    const col = r.kind==="sel"||r.kind==="ref" ? "var(--base)" : r.kind==="pool" ? "var(--ink)" : "var(--accent)";
    const lab = el("text",{x:left-10,y:r.sub?cy-2:cy+4.5,"font-size":fs,"text-anchor":"end","font-weight":r.kind==="pool"?600:400, fill: r.kind==="sel"?"var(--muted)":"var(--ink)"},g); lab.textContent=r.label;
    if(r.sub){ const s=el("text",{x:left-10,y:cy+12,"font-size":11,"text-anchor":"end",fill:"var(--muted)"},g); s.textContent=r.sub; }
    if(r.kind==="pool"){
      el("polygon",{points:`${x(r.lo)},${cy} ${x(r.est)},${cy-8} ${x(r.hi)},${cy} ${x(r.est)},${cy+8}`,fill:"var(--ink)"},g);
    } else {
      el("line",{x1:x(r.lo),x2:x(r.hi),y1:cy,y2:cy,stroke:col,"stroke-width":2.2},g);
      [r.lo,r.hi].forEach(v=>el("line",{x1:x(v),x2:x(v),y1:cy-5,y2:cy+5,stroke:col,"stroke-width":2},g));
      if(r.kind==="ref"||r.kind==="sel") el("rect",{x:x(r.est)-6,y:cy-6,width:12,height:12,fill:col},g);
      else el("circle",{cx:x(r.est),cy:cy,r:6.5,fill:col,stroke:"#fff","stroke-width":1.5},g);
    }
    if(showVals){ const v=el("text",{x:W-4,y:cy+4.5,"font-size":12,"text-anchor":"end",fill:"var(--ink2)"},g); v.textContent=r.val; }
    bindMark(g, r.tip);
  });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- grouped bars ---------- */
function drawBars(box, cats, series, o){
  box.innerHTML="";
  const W = Math.max(300, box.clientWidth), H = o.height || 300;
  let ymax = 0; series.forEach(s=>s.values.forEach(v=>{ ymax=Math.max(ymax, v.hi!==undefined?v.hi:v.v); }));
  ymax *= 1.08;
  const tk = niceTicks(0, ymax, 5); const top = tk.ticks[tk.ticks.length-1] < ymax ? tk.ticks[tk.ticks.length-1]+tk.step : tk.ticks[tk.ticks.length-1];
  if(tk.ticks[tk.ticks.length-1] < top) tk.ticks.push(+top.toFixed(10));
  let tlw = 0; tk.ticks.forEach(t=>{ tlw=Math.max(tlw, tw(tickFmt(t,tk.step),12)); });
  const ml = 14 + 16 + Math.ceil(tlw) + 8, mr = 8, mt = 14, mb = 48;
  const pw = W-ml-mr, ph = H-mt-mb;
  const y = v => mt + ph - v/top*ph;
  const svg = el("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,role:"group","aria-label":o.aria},box);
  tk.ticks.forEach(t=>{ el("line",{x1:ml,x2:ml+pw,y1:y(t),y2:y(t),stroke:"var(--grid)"},svg);
    const tt=el("text",{x:ml-8,y:y(t)+4,"font-size":12,"text-anchor":"end"},svg); tt.textContent=tickFmt(t,tk.step); });
  const yt = el("text",{x:0,y:0,"font-size":13,"font-weight":600,"text-anchor":"middle",transform:`translate(${14},${mt+ph/2}) rotate(-90)`},svg); yt.textContent=o.ylabel;
  el("line",{x1:ml,x2:ml+pw,y1:y(0),y2:y(0),stroke:"var(--ink2)"},svg);
  const gw = pw/cats.length, ns = Math.max(1, series.length), bw = Math.min(46, gw*0.78/ns);
  cats.forEach((c,ci_)=>{
    const cx = ml + gw*ci_ + gw/2;
    const ct = el("text",{x:cx,y:mt+ph+18,"font-size":12.5,"text-anchor":"middle",fill:"var(--ink)"},svg); ct.textContent=c;
    series.forEach((s,si)=>{
      const v = s.values[ci_]; const bx = cx - bw*ns/2 + si*bw;
      const g = el("g",{},svg);
      el("rect",{class:"hit",x:bx-1,y:mt,width:bw+2,height:ph,fill:"transparent"},g);
      el("rect",{class:"bar",x:bx+1,y:y(Math.max(0,v.v)),width:bw-2,height:Math.abs(y(v.v)-y(0)),fill:s.color},g);
      if(v.lo!==undefined){ const wx=bx+bw/2; el("line",{x1:wx,x2:wx,y1:y(Math.max(0,v.lo)),y2:y(v.hi),stroke:"var(--ink)","stroke-width":1.4},g);
        el("line",{x1:wx-4,x2:wx+4,y1:y(v.hi),y2:y(v.hi),stroke:"var(--ink)","stroke-width":1.4},g);
        if(v.lo>=0) el("line",{x1:wx-4,x2:wx+4,y1:y(v.lo),y2:y(v.lo),stroke:"var(--ink)","stroke-width":1.4},g); }
      if(o.valueLabels && bw>=26){ const lt=el("text",{x:bx+bw/2,y:y(v.v)-(v.hi!==undefined? (y(v.v)-y(v.hi))+4 : 4),"font-size":11,"text-anchor":"middle",fill:"var(--ink2)"},g); lt.textContent=v.label; }
      bindMark(g, v.tip);
    });
  });
  if(o.xlabel){ const xt=el("text",{x:ml+pw/2,y:H-6,"font-size":13,"font-weight":600,"text-anchor":"middle"},svg); xt.textContent=o.xlabel; }
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- responsive redraw ---------- */
const redrawers = [];
function onResize(fn){ redrawers.push(fn); }
let lastW = window.innerWidth, rt;
window.addEventListener("resize", ()=>{ clearTimeout(rt); rt=setTimeout(()=>{ if(Math.abs(window.innerWidth-lastW)>2){ lastW=window.innerWidth; redrawers.forEach(f=>f()); } }, 120); });

/* ---------- term tooltips ---------- */
const TERMS = {
  OPEN:["OPEN index","The mean of six signed z-scored ego-network components from the early window (t0 to t0+2): new edge rate, number of Leiden communities reached, participation coefficient and neighbourhood novelty residual (positive sign), and ego density and edge persistence (negative sign). The z-score constants are frozen from the DEV data."],
  OPENhome:["OPEN home","OPEN computed on the home-field co-occurrence graph only. It is free of mechanical coupling with the breadth outcome, and its signal is marginal."],
  OPENall:["OPEN all","OPEN computed on the corpus-wide graph. It is partly mechanically coupled to the outcome, because early off-home papers that enter the ego network are also papers that determine later breadth."],
  OPENsize:["OPEN sizematch","OPEN computed on corpus-wide papers subsampled to home counts, which controls for the paper-count part of the coupling."],
  home:["Home field","The field or fields holding at least 40% of a concept's first 30 grounded papers."],
  cooc:["Co-occurrence neighbourhood","The concept's ego network on the topic co-occurrence backbone: the topics that appear with it on the same papers, and the links among those topics."],
  onset:["Onset year t0","The first year a concept reaches 20 grounded publications."],
  O2r:["Rarefied field breadth (O2r, m = 50)","The expected number of distinct venue fields among a fixed-size random draw of m papers from a concept's publications in years t0+6 to t0+8, computed by exact hypergeometric rarefaction. Rarefaction separates size-adjusted breadth from sheer volume."],
  B5:["Five-feature baseline (B5)","Log early volume, publication growth, non-home share, Shannon entropy and field reach, all computed over t0 to t0+2."],
  PSP:["Partial Spearman priority (PSP)","The Pearson correlation of rank-transformed indicator and outcome residuals, both residualised on the baseline covariates and control rungs. Inference uses 2,000 concept-level bootstrap resamples with refit."],
  rung:["Control rung","A step on the ladder of increasingly demanding baselines. R2 controls for B5 plus onset year, contact reach, concept type, a generic-concept flag and concept level. R3 is the footprint rung, which adds the pre-onset footprint; R0 is the lowest rung."],
  DL:["DerSimonian–Laird pool","A random-effects estimator that pools estimates across field groups or bodies, reported with the I² heterogeneity statistic."],
  I2:["I²","The share of variation across pooled estimates attributed to real heterogeneity rather than sampling error. 0 means the bodies agree within their sampling noise."],
  DEV:["DEV set","Concepts with home fields in Computer Science, Engineering and Biochemistry/Genetics/Medicine, onset 2003–2009. Indicators and the OPEN index were chosen on it, so it is selection data."],
  heldout:["Held-out groups","The remaining field families (Physical Sciences, Life & Environment, Social Sciences, Math & Decision Sciences), scored once after the specification was hash-sealed on DEV."],
  placebo:["Placebo null band","The 95th percentile of the absolute partial Spearman when the outcome is permuted within the body (200 draws, rung R2). An estimate inside the band is no larger than chance correlation of that body's size."],
  NOVCHURN:["NOVCHURN","The mean of z(NOV_res) and −z(edge persistence), a two-component novelty/churn measure used in the mechanism analyses."],
  NOVres:["Neighbourhood novelty residual (NOV_res)","The novelty of a concept's co-occurrence partners after residualising on degree."],
  persist:["Edge persistence","The fraction of the concept's neighbours retained across windows. It enters OPEN with a negative sign."],
  density:["Ego density","The density of the concept's local co-occurrence subgraph. It enters OPEN with a negative sign."],
  newedge:["New edge rate","The fraction of a concept's co-occurrence neighbours that are new."],
  ncomm:["Communities reached (n_comm)","How many distinct Leiden topic communities a concept's neighbours span."],
  partic:["Participation coefficient","The share of a concept's ties that cross community boundaries."],
  clogit:["Conditional logit","A model of field entry on concept-year risk sets, stratified by concept-year (Breslow partial likelihood), with standardised covariates. Each stratum compares the field a concept entered with the fields it could have entered that year."],
  d0:["Retained-frontier coefficient d0","The log-odds of entering a field per SD of relatedness to the off-home fields that currently retain the concept, at rung R3 of the entry model."],
  retained:["Retaining field","A field is retaining a concept when it has published at least two grounded papers on the concept in each of the two most recent years."],
  PMI:["PMI backbone","Relatedness between fields measured by positive pointwise mutual information on the field-level backbone."],
  mincp:["Minimum conditional probability","The standard product-space proximity of Hidalgo et al. (2007). Under this proximity instead of PMI, d0 reverses sign."],
  volmatch:["Volume-matched contrast","A pre-registered test comparing entry rates of retained versus entered-but-not-retained fields in the same volume cell. It separates persistence from sheer volume."]
};
const termTips = [];
function openTerm(t){ termTips.forEach(x=>{ if(x!==t){ x.tipEl.hidden=true; } }); t.tipEl.hidden=false; placeTerm(t); }
function placeTerm(t){ const r=t.btn.getBoundingClientRect(); const tp=t.tipEl; tp.style.left="0px"; tp.style.top="0px";
  const tr=tp.getBoundingClientRect(); let x=r.left+window.scrollX; x=Math.max(8+window.scrollX, Math.min(x, window.scrollX+document.documentElement.clientWidth-tr.width-8));
  let yy=r.bottom+window.scrollY+6; tp.style.left=x+"px"; tp.style.top=yy+"px"; }
function closeAllTerms(){ termTips.forEach(x=>x.tipEl.hidden=true); }
function initTerms(root){
  (root||document).querySelectorAll("button.term:not([data-bound])").forEach((b,i)=>{
    const key=b.dataset.term, d=TERMS[key]; if(!d) return;
    b.setAttribute("data-bound","1"); b.type="button";
    const id="tt-"+key+"-"+termTips.length;
    const tp=h("div",{class:"termtip",role:"tooltip",id:id},"<b>"+esc(d[0])+"</b>"+esc(d[1])); tp.hidden=true; document.body.appendChild(tp);
    b.setAttribute("aria-describedby", id);
    const t={btn:b, tipEl:tp}; termTips.push(t);
    ["mouseenter","focus","click"].forEach(ev=>b.addEventListener(ev, e=>{ openTerm(t); }));
    b.addEventListener("mouseleave", ()=>{ tp.hidden=true; });
  });
}
document.addEventListener("click", e=>{ if(!e.target.closest("button.term")) closeAllTerms(); });
document.addEventListener("keydown", e=>{ if(e.key==="Escape") closeAllTerms(); });

/* ---------- segmented controls ---------- */
function makeRadio(container, items, value, onChange){
  container.innerHTML="";
  const btns = items.map(it=>{ const b=h("button",{type:"button",role:"radio","aria-checked":String(it.v===value)},it.label); b.dataset.v=it.v; container.appendChild(b); return b; });
  function set(v, focus){ btns.forEach(b=>{ const on=b.dataset.v===v; b.setAttribute("aria-checked",String(on)); b.tabIndex=on?0:-1; if(on&&focus) b.focus(); }); onChange(v); }
  btns.forEach((b,i)=>{ b.tabIndex = b.dataset.v===value?0:-1;
    b.addEventListener("click",()=>set(b.dataset.v));
    b.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{ if(e.key==="ArrowRight"||e.key==="ArrowDown"){ e.preventDefault(); set(btns[(i+1)%btns.length].dataset.v,true);} if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"||e.key==="ArrowUp"){ e.preventDefault(); set(btns[(i-1+btns.length)%btns.length].dataset.v,true);} });
  });
}

/* =====================================================================
   1. Headline forest
   ===================================================================== */
const BODY = {B2_PHYS:"Physical Sciences",B2_LIFEENV:"Life & Environment",B2_SOC:"Social Sciences",B2_MATHDEC:"Math & Decision",
  B3_EXP5_COHORT_2010_14:"Cohort 2010–14",B4_COHORT_2015_17:"Cohort 2015–17",B1_DEV:"DEV (selection)"};
const BODY_ORDER = ["B2_PHYS","B2_LIFEENV","B2_SOC","B2_MATHDEC","B3_EXP5_COHORT_2010_14","B4_COHORT_2015_17"];
const FEAT = {OPEN_home:"OPEN<sub>home</sub>", NOVCHURN_home:"NOVCHURN<sub>home</sub>"};
const FEATT = {OPEN_home:"OPEN home", NOVCHURN_home:"NOVCHURN home"};
const H = {feat:"OPEN_home", rung:"R2", dev:false, band:true};
function headlineRows(){
  const pool = EV.pools[H.feat+"|"+H.rung];
  const rows=[];
  const order = BODY_ORDER.concat(H.dev?["B1_DEV"]:[]);
  order.forEach((b,i)=>{
    const r = EV.rows.find(x=>x.body===b && x.feature===H.feat); if(!r) return;
    const s = r[H.rung]; const inPool = pool.bodies.indexOf(b)>=0;
    const kind = inPool ? "body" : "sel";
    rows.push({label:BODY[b] + (inPool?"":" (selection)"), sub:"n = "+s.n.toLocaleString("en-US"), est:s.psp, lo:s.ci[0], hi:s.ci[1], kind:kind,
      band: (H.band && H.rung==="R2") ? [-r.placebo_p95, r.placebo_p95] : null, sep: b==="B1_DEV",
      val: sgn(s.psp)+" "+ci(s.ci),
      tip:`<b>${BODY[b]}</b><br>${FEATT[H.feat]}, rung ${H.rung}: ${sgn(s.psp)} ${ci(s.ci)}<br>${s.n.toLocaleString("en-US")} concepts analysed; status: ${esc(r.status)}${H.rung==="R2"?"<br>Placebo 95th pct |ρ|: "+num(r.placebo_p95):""}${inPool?"":"<br>Not pooled: selection data for this index."}`});
  });
  rows.push({label:"DL pool, "+pool.k+" bodies", est:pool.est, lo:pool.ci[0], hi:pool.ci[1], kind:"pool", sep:!H.dev,
    val: sgn(pool.est)+" "+ci(pool.ci),
    tip:`<b>DerSimonian–Laird pool</b><br>${sgn(pool.est)} ${ci(pool.ci)}, I² = ${+pool.I2.toFixed(2)}, ${pool.sign} positive`});
  return {rows, pool};
}
function drawHeadline(){
  const {rows, pool} = headlineRows();
  drawForest(document.getElementById("chart-headline"), rows, {xlabel:"Partial Spearman ρ with O2r (m = 50), given rung "+H.rung, aria:"Forest plot of "+FEATT[H.feat]+" by body", refLine:pool.est});
  const lg = document.getElementById("legend-headline");
  lg.innerHTML = `<span><i class="sw dot" style="background:var(--accent)"></i>body, 95% bootstrap CI</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--ink);transform:rotate(45deg);width:11px;height:11px"></i>pooled estimate</span><span><i class="sw line"></i>zero</span><span><i class="sw line" style="border-top-style:dotted;border-top-color:var(--ink)"></i>pooled value</span>`+
    (H.band && H.rung==="R2" ? `<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--base-soft);border:1px solid #d5d8dc"></i><button class="term" data-term="placebo">placebo null band</button></span>`:"")+
    (rows.some(r=>r.kind==="sel") ? `<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></i>selection body, not pooled</span>`:"");
  initTerms(lg);
  const ns = rows.filter(r=>r.kind==="body");
  const pos = ns.filter(r=>r.est>0).length, excl = ns.filter(r=>r.lo>0).length;
  let t = `${FEAT[H.feat]} at rung ${H.rung}: positive in ${pos} of ${ns.length} non-selection bodies, and ${excl} of ${ns.length} have a 95% CI above zero on their own. The pool is ${sgn(pool.est)} ${ci(pool.ci)}, I<sup>2</sup> = ${+pool.I2.toFixed(2)}.`;
  if(H.dev){ const d = EV.rows.find(x=>x.body==="B1_DEV"&&x.feature===H.feat)[H.rung]; t += ` The DEV body, on which the index was chosen, gives ${sgn(d.psp)}, ${pool.shrinkage.toFixed(2)}× the pool: the usual shrinkage from selection to new data.`; }
  if(H.band && H.rung==="R2"){ const inside = ns.filter(r=>r.band && r.est < r.band[1]).length; t += ` ${inside} of ${ns.length} body estimates sit inside their own placebo band.`; }
  document.getElementById("tk-headline").innerHTML = t;
  const bandBox = document.getElementById("ctl-band"); bandBox.disabled = H.rung!=="R2";
  bandBox.parentElement.title = H.rung!=="R2" ? "The placebo was run at rung R2 only" : "";
}
makeRadio(document.getElementById("ctl-feat"), [{v:"OPEN_home",label:"OPEN<sub>home</sub>"},{v:"NOVCHURN_home",label:"NOVCHURN<sub>home</sub>"}], H.feat, v=>{H.feat=v; drawHeadline();});
makeRadio(document.getElementById("ctl-rung"), [{v:"R0",label:"R0"},{v:"R2",label:"R2"},{v:"R3",label:"R3"}], H.rung, v=>{H.rung=v; drawHeadline();});
document.getElementById("ctl-dev").addEventListener("change", e=>{H.dev=e.target.checked; drawHeadline();});
document.getElementById("ctl-band").addEventListener("change", e=>{H.band=e.target.checked; drawHeadline();});
(function(){ const p=EV.pools["OPEN_home|R2"];
  document.getElementById("big-num").innerHTML = sgn(p.est)+' <small>'+ci(p.ci)+'</small>';
  document.getElementById("big-cap").innerHTML = `Pooled partial Spearman of OPEN<sub>home</sub> with later breadth at rung R2, over ${p.k} bodies not used for selection; I<sup>2</sup> = ${+p.I2.toFixed(2)}, ${p.sign} positive.`;
})();
drawHeadline(); onResize(drawHeadline);

/* =====================================================================
   Cohort records
   ===================================================================== */
const C = CO.cols; const IX = {}; C.forEach((c,i)=>IX[c]=i);
const COMPS = ["new_edge_rate","n_comm_W3","participation","NOV_res","ego_density_W3","edge_persistence"];
const COMPL = {new_edge_rate:"New edge rate",n_comm_W3:"Communities reached",participation:"Participation coefficient",NOV_res:"Novelty residual (NOV_res)",ego_density_W3:"Ego density",edge_persistence:"Edge persistence"};
const COMPT = {new_edge_rate:"newedge",n_comm_W3:"ncomm",participation:"partic",NOV_res:"NOVres",ego_density_W3:"density",edge_persistence:"persist"};
const GRP = {CS:"Computer Science",Eng:"Engineering",BGM:"Biochemistry & Genetics",Med:"Medicine",PHYS:"Physical Sciences",LIFEENV:"Life & Environment",SOC:"Social Sciences",MATHDEC:"Math & Decision"};
const B5K = ["logvol","growth_c","offhome_share","entropy","reach"];
const B5L = {logvol:"Log early volume",growth_c:"Publication growth",offhome_share:"Non-home share",entropy:"Shannon entropy",reach:"Field reach"};
const recs = CO.rows.map((r,i)=>{ const o={i:i}; C.forEach((c,j)=>o[c]=r[j]);
  o.scored = o.O2r_m50!==null && o.OPEN_home!==null && o.pred_b5_open!==null && o.pred_b5!==null;
  if(o.scored){ o.e0=Math.abs(o.O2r_m50-o.pred_b5); o.e1=Math.abs(o.O2r_m50-o.pred_b5_open); o.gain=o.e0-o.e1; o.resid=o.O2r_m50-o.pred_b5; }
  return o; });
const scored = recs.filter(r=>r.scored);
const openSorted = scored.map(r=>r.OPEN_home).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
function pctRank(v){ let k=0; while(k<openSorted.length && openSorted[k]<=v) k++; return Math.round(100*k/openSorted.length); }

/* live OPEN + predictions (exact frozen formulas) */
function zOf(k, v){ const c=SP.constants[k]; if(v===null||v===undefined||!isFinite(v)) return null; const cl=Math.min(Math.max(v,c.lo),c.hi); return c.sign*(cl-c.mu)/c.sd; }
function openOf(vals, nHome){ const zs=[]; COMPS.forEach(k=>{ const z=zOf(k, vals[k]); if(z!==null) zs.push(z); });
  if(zs.length<SP.min_comp || nHome<SP.min_home) return {open:null, used:zs.length};
  return {open: zs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/zs.length, used:zs.length}; }
function predOf(r, open){ const x=[1].concat(B5K.map(k=>(r[k]-SP.B5.mu[k])/SP.B5.sd[k]));
  const p0 = x.reduce((a,v,i)=>a+v*SP.B5.coef[i],0);
  const p1 = open===null? null : x.concat([open]).reduce((a,v,i)=>a+v*SP.B5_plus_OPEN_home.coef[i],0);
  return {p0, p1}; }

/* =====================================================================
   2. Stepper
   ===================================================================== */
const EX = recs.find(r=>r.name==="Word embedding");
const STAGES = ["Ground and date","Early neighbourhood","Clip and standardise","Average into OPEN","Baseline forecast","Later breadth","Test across concepts"];
let stage = 0;
function kvs(pairs){ return pairs.map(p=>`<div class="kv"><span>${p[0]}</span><span>${p[1]}</span></div>`).join(""); }
function stageHTML(s){
  const r = EX; const o = openOf(Object.fromEntries(COMPS.map(k=>[k,r[k+"__home"]])), r.n_home_early);
  const cohortRow = EV.rows.find(x=>x.body==="B4_COHORT_2015_17"&&x.feature==="OPEN_home").R2; const pool=EV.pools["OPEN_home|R2"];
  const P = predOf(r, r.OPEN_home);
  const cells = [];
  if(s===0) cells.push(["What goes in","OpenAlex works whose titles match the concept's label, verified by stemmed matching, with a per-concept LLM precision gate that drops concepts below 0.80 precision."],
    ["What is done","The <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"onset\">onset year</button> is the first year with 20 grounded papers. The <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"home\">home field</button> holds at least 40% of the first 30 papers."],
    ["What comes out", kvs([["Concept", esc(r.name)],["Onset year t<sub>0</sub>", r.t0],["Home group", GRP[r.group]||r.group],["Papers t<sub>0</sub>..t<sub>0</sub>+2, all fields", r.n_all_early],["Papers t<sub>0</sub>..t<sub>0</sub>+2, home field", r.n_home_early]])],
    ["Why","Fixing t<sub>0</sub> fixes the early window. Every predictor below uses only papers up to t<sub>0</sub>+2; the outcome uses papers six to eight years after onset."]);
  if(s===1) cells.push(["What goes in", `The ${r.n_home_early} home-field papers from t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+2 and the topics they carry, placed on the topic co-occurrence backbone.`],
    ["What is done","The concept's ego network is built from the topics that co-occur with it. Six structural properties are measured on it."],
    ["What comes out", kvs(COMPS.map(k=>[`<button class="term" data-term="${COMPT[k]}">${COMPL[k]}</button>`, r[k+"__home"]===null?"not measured":num(r[k+"__home"],3)]))],
    ["Why","Four components reward partners that are new or cross community lines; two (density, persistence) reward a closed, stable neighbourhood and enter with a negative sign."]);
  if(s===2){ const rows = COMPS.map(k=>{ const c=SP.constants[k]; const v=r[k+"__home"]; const z=zOf(k,v);
      return `<tr><td>${COMPL[k]}</td><td class="num">${v===null?"n/a":num(v,3)}</td><td class="num">${num(c.mu,3)}</td><td class="num">${num(c.sd,3)}</td><td class="num">${c.sign>0?"+":MINUS}</td><td class="num"><b>${z===null?"n/a":sgn(z,2)}</b></td></tr>`; }).join("");
    cells.push(["What goes in","The six raw values from the previous stage, and constants frozen on the 12,499-concept frame before the cohort's outcomes were opened."],
      ["What is done","Each value is clipped to the frozen 0.5th–99.5th percentile bounds, centred on the frozen mean, divided by the frozen SD and multiplied by its sign."],
      ["What comes out", `<div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Component</th><th class="num">raw</th><th class="num">mean</th><th class="num">SD</th><th class="num">sign</th><th class="num">z</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div>`],
      ["Why","Freezing the constants means the cohort cannot shape its own yardstick: a z-score of +1 means one frozen-frame SD more open than the average concept of 2003–2014."]); }
  if(s===3) cells.push(["What goes in", `${o.used} finite signed z-scores (at least ${SP.min_comp} are required, and at least ${SP.min_home} home papers).`],
    ["What is done","The z-scores are averaged with equal weight."],
    ["What comes out", kvs([["OPEN<sub>home</sub>, recomputed here", sgn(o.open,3)],["OPEN<sub>home</sub>, stored in the file", sgn(r.OPEN_home,3)],["Percentile among the 573 scored cohort concepts", pctRank(r.OPEN_home)+"th"]])],
    ["Why","One number summarises how open the early neighbourhood is. Averaging signed components keeps any one of them from dominating."]);
  if(s===4) cells.push(["What goes in", kvs(B5K.map(k=>[B5L[k], num(r[k],3)]))],
    ["What is done","Two linear models frozen on the earlier frame predict breadth: one from <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"B5\">B5</button> alone, one from B5 plus OPEN<sub>home</sub>."],
    ["What comes out", kvs([["B5 forecast (stored)", num(r.pred_b5,2)],["B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub> forecast (stored)", num(r.pred_b5_open,2)],["Recomputed here", num(P.p0,2)+" / "+num(P.p1,2)]])],
    ["Why","The baseline is strong. Any network signal has to add something on top of how much, how fast and how widely a concept is already being published."]);
  if(s===5) cells.push(["What goes in", "The concept's papers from t<sub>0</sub>+6 to t<sub>0</sub>+8."],
    ["What is done","<button class=\"term\" data-term=\"O2r\">Rarefied breadth</button>: the expected number of distinct venue fields in a random draw of 50 of those papers."],
    ["What comes out", kvs([["Observed O<sub>2r</sub> (m = 50)", num(r.O2r_m50,2)],["Error of B5 forecast", num(r.e0,2)],["Error of B5 + OPEN forecast", num(r.e1,2)]])],
    ["Why", `For this concept, adding OPEN moves the forecast ${r.gain>0?"towards":"away from"} the observed value by ${num(Math.abs(r.gain),2)} fields. One concept is not evidence; the next stage is.`]);
  if(s===6) cells.push(["What goes in", `All ${cohortRow.n} cohort concepts with both a breadth outcome and an OPEN<sub>home</sub> score.`],
    ["What is done","<button class=\"term\" data-term=\"PSP\">Partial Spearman</button>: rank-correlate OPEN<sub>home</sub> and breadth after removing the controls of rung R2 from both, with 2,000 concept bootstraps. The same is done in five other bodies and pooled."],
    ["What comes out", kvs([["This cohort, R2", sgn(cohortRow.psp)+" "+ci(cohortRow.ci)],["Six-body DL pool, R2", sgn(pool.est)+" "+ci(pool.ci)],["I<sup>2</sup> / sign agreement", (+pool.I2.toFixed(2))+" / "+pool.sign]])],
    ["Why","A single forecast can go either way. The claim rests on a small, consistent tilt across hundreds of concepts in each body."]);
  return cells.map((c,i)=>`<div class="cell${i===3?" why":""}"><h4>${c[0]}</h4><div>${c[1]}</div></div>`).join("");
}
function drawPipeline(){
  const box=document.getElementById("chart-pipeline"); box.innerHTML="";
  const W=Math.max(300, box.clientWidth); const two = W<640; const perRow = two?4:7; const rows = two?2:1;
  const rowH=74, H=rows*rowH+8; const svg=el("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,"aria-hidden":"true"},box);
  const colW = W/perRow;
  const pos = STAGES.map((s,i)=>{ const rr=Math.floor(i/perRow), cc=i%perRow; return {x:colW*cc+colW/2, y:rr*rowH+24}; });
  for(let i=0;i<STAGES.length-1;i++){ const a=pos[i], b=pos[i+1]; if(a.y===b.y) el("line",{x1:a.x+15,x2:b.x-15,y1:a.y,y2:b.y,stroke:i<stage?"var(--accent)":"var(--line)","stroke-width":2},svg); }
  STAGES.forEach((s,i)=>{ const p=pos[i]; const g=el("g",{style:"cursor:pointer"},svg);
    el("circle",{cx:p.x,cy:p.y,r:14,fill:i===stage?"var(--accent)":i<stage?"var(--accent-soft)":"#fff",stroke:i<=stage?"var(--accent)":"var(--base)","stroke-width":2},g);
    const n=el("text",{x:p.x,y:p.y+4.5,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":13,"font-weight":700,fill:i===stage?"#fff":"var(--ink)"},g); n.textContent=i+1;
    const fsz = Math.min(12.5, 12.5*Math.min(1,(colW-6)/Math.max(1,tw(s,12.5))));
    const t=el("text",{x:p.x,y:p.y+34,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":fsz,"font-weight":i===stage?700:400,fill:i===stage?"var(--ink)":"var(--muted)"},g); t.textContent=s;
    g.addEventListener("click",()=>setStage(i)); });
}
const mk = document.getElementById("step-markers");
STAGES.forEach((s,i)=>{ const li=h("li"); const b=h("button",{type:"button","aria-label":"Stage "+(i+1)+": "+s},String(i+1)); b.addEventListener("click",()=>setStage(i)); li.appendChild(b); mk.appendChild(li); });
function setStage(i, fromKey){
  stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i));
  mk.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((b,j)=>{ if(j===stage) b.setAttribute("aria-current","step"); else b.removeAttribute("aria-current"); });
  document.getElementById("step-title").textContent = "Stage "+(stage+1)+" of "+STAGES.length+": "+STAGES[stage];
  document.getElementById("step-body").innerHTML = stageHTML(stage); initTerms(document.getElementById("step-body"));
  document.getElementById("step-prev").disabled = stage===0; document.getElementById("step-next").disabled = stage===STAGES.length-1;
  document.getElementById("step-live").textContent = "Stage "+(stage+1)+" of "+STAGES.length+": "+STAGES[stage];
  const tk=["The concept is dated and placed in a home field, which fixes a three-year early window.","Six numbers describe how open the early home neighbourhood is.","Each component is now on a common scale set by the frozen development frame.",`${esc(EX.name)} scores ${sgn(EX.OPEN_home,2)}: more open than ${pctRank(EX.OPEN_home)}% of scored cohort concepts.`,`OPEN raises the forecast from ${num(EX.pred_b5,2)} to ${num(EX.pred_b5_open,2)} fields.`,`The observed breadth, ${num(EX.O2r_m50,2)}, is above both forecasts; OPEN closed ${num(EX.gain,2)} of the ${num(EX.e0,2)}-field gap.`,"Across the cohort the tilt is small but positive, and it has the same sign in all six bodies."];
  document.getElementById("tk-stepper").innerHTML = tk[stage];
  drawPipeline();
}
document.getElementById("step-prev").addEventListener("click",()=>setStage(stage-1));
document.getElementById("step-next").addEventListener("click",()=>setStage(stage+1));
document.getElementById("v-stepper").addEventListener("keydown", e=>{ if(e.target.closest("input,select,textarea")) return; if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){ e.preventDefault(); setStage(stage+1);} if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){ e.preventDefault(); setStage(stage-1);} });
document.getElementById("stepper-concept").innerHTML = `Example: <b>${esc(EX.name)}</b>, a ${GRP[EX.group]} concept with onset ${EX.t0}.`;
setStage(0); onResize(drawPipeline);

/* =====================================================================
   3a. Item browser
   ===================================================================== */
const BR = {q:"", g:"all", sort:"open_desc", scored:true, hurt:false, limit:60, sel:EX.i};
const groups = Object.keys(GRP).filter(g=>recs.some(r=>r.group===g));
[["br-group"],["sc-group"]].forEach(([id])=>{ const s=document.getElementById(id); s.appendChild(h("option",{value:"all"},"All home groups")); groups.forEach(g=>s.appendChild(h("option",{value:g},GRP[g]))); });
document.querySelector('#br-sort option[value="open_desc"]').textContent = "OPEN home high to low";
function brFiltered(){
  const q=BR.q.trim().toLowerCase();
  let a = recs.filter(r=>(BR.g==="all"||r.group===BR.g) && (!BR.scored||r.scored) && (!q||r.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) && (!BR.hurt||(r.scored&&r.gain<0)));
  const key = {open_desc:(x,y)=>(y.OPEN_home??-99)-(x.OPEN_home??-99), open_asc:(x,y)=>(x.OPEN_home??99)-(y.OPEN_home??99), y_desc:(x,y)=>(y.O2r_m50??-99)-(x.O2r_m50??-99),
    gain_desc:(x,y)=>(y.gain??-99)-(x.gain??-99), gain_asc:(x,y)=>(x.gain??99)-(y.gain??99), name:(x,y)=>x.name.localeCompare(y.name)}[BR.sort];
  return a.sort(key);
}
function numberLine(box, r){
  box.innerHTML=""; if(!r.scored) return;
  const W=Math.max(260, box.clientWidth), H=62; const vals=[r.O2r_m50, r.pred_b5, r.pred_b5_open];
  let lo=Math.min(...vals), hi=Math.max(...vals); const pad=Math.max(0.5,(hi-lo)*0.25); lo-=pad; hi+=pad;
  const tk=niceTicks(lo,hi,Math.max(3,Math.floor(W/70))); lo=Math.min(lo,tk.ticks[0]); hi=Math.max(hi,tk.ticks[tk.ticks.length-1]);
  const x=v=>12+(v-lo)/(hi-lo)*(W-24);
  const svg=el("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,role:"group","aria-label":"Observed breadth and the two forecasts on one axis"},box);
  tk.ticks.forEach(t=>{ el("line",{x1:x(t),x2:x(t),y1:8,y2:34,stroke:"var(--grid)"},svg); const tt=el("text",{x:x(t),y:50,"font-size":11.5,"text-anchor":"middle"},svg); tt.textContent=tickFmt(t,tk.step); });
  el("line",{x1:12,x2:W-12,y1:34,y2:34,stroke:"var(--line)"},svg);
  const mk_=[[r.pred_b5,"var(--base)","B5 forecast","rect"],[r.pred_b5_open,"var(--accent)","B5 + OPEN forecast","circle"],[r.O2r_m50,"var(--ink)","Observed breadth","diamond"]];
  mk_.forEach(m=>{ const g=el("g",{},svg); el("rect",{class:"hit",x:x(m[0])-9,y:9,width:18,height:24,fill:"transparent"},g);
    if(m[3]==="rect") el("rect",{x:x(m[0])-6,y:15,width:12,height:12,fill:m[1]},g);
    else if(m[3]==="circle") el("circle",{cx:x(m[0]),cy:21,r:6.5,fill:m[1],stroke:"#fff","stroke-width":1.5},g);
    else el("polygon",{points:`${x(m[0])},12 ${x(m[0])+7},21 ${x(m[0])},30 ${x(m[0])-7},21`,fill:m[1]},g);
    bindMark(g, `<b>${m[2]}</b>: ${num(m[0],2)} fields`); });
  const xl=el("text",{x:W/2,y:H-1,"font-size":11.5,"text-anchor":"middle","font-weight":600},svg); xl.textContent="Rarefied breadth O2r (fields in a draw of 50 papers)";
}
function brDetail(){
  const r = recs[BR.sel]; const d=document.getElementById("br-detail");
  const comps = COMPS.map(k=>[COMPL[k], r[k+"__home"]===null?"not measured":num(r[k+"__home"],3)]);
  let verdict = "";
  if(r.scored){ verdict = r.gain>0 ? `<span class="pill pass">OPEN helped</span> Adding OPEN<sub>home</sub> moved the forecast ${num(r.gain,2)} fields closer to the observed breadth.` : `<span class="pill fail">OPEN hurt</span> Adding OPEN<sub>home</sub> moved the forecast ${num(-r.gain,2)} fields further from the observed breadth.`; }
  else verdict = `<span class="pill fail">Not scored</span> ${r.O2r_m50===null?"No breadth outcome was recorded (too few papers in t<sub>0</sub>+6..t<sub>0</sub>+8).":"OPEN<sub>home</sub> is undefined: fewer than "+SP.min_home+" home papers or fewer than "+SP.min_comp+" measurable components."}`;
  d.innerHTML = `<h3 style="margin-bottom:2px">${esc(r.name)}</h3><p class="small" style="margin:0 0 10px">${GRP[r.group]||r.group}, onset ${r.t0}; ${r.n_all_early} papers in the early window, ${r.n_home_early} in the home field${r.type?"; concept type: "+esc(r.type):""}</p>
  <div class="side">
    <div class="cell"><h4>Input: early window</h4>${kvs(B5K.map(k=>[B5L[k],num(r[k],3)]))}${kvs(comps)}</div>
    <div class="cell base"><h4>Baseline: B5 only</h4>${kvs([["Forecast breadth", num(r.pred_b5,2)],["Error", r.scored?num(r.e0,2):"n/a"]])}</div>
    <div class="cell method"><h4>Method: B5 + OPEN<sub>home</sub></h4>${kvs([["OPEN<sub>home</sub>", r.OPEN_home===null?"n/a":sgn(r.OPEN_home,3)],["Forecast breadth", num(r.pred_b5_open,2)],["Error", r.scored?num(r.e1,2):"n/a"],["Observed breadth", num(r.O2r_m50,2)]])}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="chart" id="br-line" style="margin-top:10px"></div>
  <div class="legend"><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></i>B5 forecast</span><span><i class="sw dot" style="background:var(--accent)"></i>B5 + OPEN forecast</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--ink);transform:rotate(45deg);width:10px;height:10px"></i>observed</span></div>
  <p class="verdict">${verdict}</p>`;
  numberLine(document.getElementById("br-line"), r);
}
function brRender(){
  const a = brFiltered(); const list=document.getElementById("br-list"); list.innerHTML="";
  const show = a.slice(0, BR.limit);
  show.forEach(r=>{ const b=h("button",{type:"button",role:"option","aria-selected":String(r.i===BR.sel),id:"opt-"+r.i});
    b.innerHTML = `<span class="nm">${esc(r.name)}<br><span class="meta">${GRP[r.group]||r.group}, ${r.t0}</span></span><span class="v" title="OPEN home">${r.OPEN_home===null?"n/a":sgn(r.OPEN_home,2)}</span><span class="v" title="Observed breadth">${num(r.O2r_m50,2)}</span>`;
    b.tabIndex=-1; b.addEventListener("click",()=>{ BR.sel=r.i; brRender(); drawScatter(); }); list.appendChild(b); });
  document.getElementById("br-more").hidden = a.length<=BR.limit;
  const sc = a.filter(r=>r.scored); const hurt = sc.filter(r=>r.gain<0).length;
  document.getElementById("br-count").textContent = `${a.length.toLocaleString("en-US")} concepts match; showing ${show.length}. Columns: OPEN home, observed breadth.`;
  if(!a.some(r=>r.i===BR.sel) && a.length) BR.sel = a[0].i;
  list.querySelectorAll('[role=option]').forEach(o=>o.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(o.id==="opt-"+BR.sel)));
  list.setAttribute("aria-activedescendant", "opt-"+BR.sel);
  brDetail();
  const tk = document.getElementById("tk-browser");
  if(!sc.length) tk.innerHTML = "No scored concepts match this filter.";
  else if(BR.hurt) tk.innerHTML = `Adding OPEN<sub>home</sub> made the forecast worse for ${hurt} of the ${recs.filter(r=>r.scored&&(BR.g==="all"||r.group===BR.g)).length} scored concepts in this selection. The median change for them is ${num(median(sc.map(r=>-r.gain)),2)} fields: the index nudges forecasts, it does not transform them.`;
  else tk.innerHTML = `Among the ${sc.length} scored concepts shown, OPEN moved the forecast closer for ${sc.length-hurt} and further for ${hurt}; the median absolute shift between the two forecasts is ${num(median(sc.map(r=>Math.abs(r.pred_b5_open-r.pred_b5))),2)} fields.`;
}
function median(a){ if(!a.length) return NaN; const s=a.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y); const m=Math.floor(s.length/2); return s.length%2?s[m]:(s[m-1]+s[m])/2; }
document.getElementById("br-search").addEventListener("input",e=>{BR.q=e.target.value;BR.limit=60;brRender();});
document.getElementById("br-group").addEventListener("change",e=>{BR.g=e.target.value;BR.limit=60;brRender();});
document.getElementById("br-sort").addEventListener("change",e=>{BR.sort=e.target.value;brRender();});
document.getElementById("br-scored").addEventListener("change",e=>{BR.scored=e.target.checked;brRender();});
document.getElementById("br-hurt").addEventListener("change",e=>{BR.hurt=e.target.checked;brRender();});
document.getElementById("br-more").addEventListener("click",()=>{BR.limit+=60;brRender();});
document.getElementById("br-list").addEventListener("keydown",e=>{
  if(e.key!=="ArrowDown"&&e.key!=="ArrowUp") return; e.preventDefault();
  const a=brFiltered().slice(0,BR.limit); let k=a.findIndex(r=>r.i===BR.sel); k = e.key==="ArrowDown"?Math.min(a.length-1,k+1):Math.max(0,k-1);
  if(a[k]){ BR.sel=a[k].i; brRender(); drawScatter(); const o=document.getElementById("opt-"+BR.sel); if(o) o.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"}); }
});
brRender(); onResize(()=>numberLine(document.getElementById("br-line"), recs[BR.sel]));

/* =====================================================================
   3b. Scatter + threshold what-if
   ===================================================================== */
const SC = {g:"all", cut:50};
function spearman(x, y){ const rk=a=>{ const idx=a.map((v,i)=>[v,i]).sort((p,q)=>p[0]-q[0]); const r=new Array(a.length); let i=0; while(i<idx.length){ let j=i; while(j+1<idx.length&&idx[j+1][0]===idx[i][0]) j++; const av=(i+j)/2+1; for(let k=i;k<=j;k++) r[idx[k][1]]=av; i=j+1; } return r; };
  const rx=rk(x), ry=rk(y); const n=x.length; const mx=rx.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/n, my=ry.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/n; let sxy=0,sxx=0,syy=0; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ sxy+=(rx[i]-mx)*(ry[i]-my); sxx+=(rx[i]-mx)**2; syy+=(ry[i]-my)**2; } return sxy/Math.sqrt(sxx*syy); }
function quantile(sorted, p){ const pos=(sorted.length-1)*p; const lo=Math.floor(pos), hi=Math.ceil(pos); return sorted[lo]+(sorted[hi]-sorted[lo])*(pos-lo); }
function drawScatter(){
  const pts = scored.filter(r=>SC.g==="all"||r.group===SC.g);
  const box=document.getElementById("chart-scatter"); box.innerHTML="";
  const W=Math.max(300, box.clientWidth), H=Math.min(420, Math.max(300, W*0.55));
  const xs=pts.map(r=>r.OPEN_home), ys=pts.map(r=>r.resid);
  let x0=Math.min(...xs), x1=Math.max(...xs), y0=Math.min(...ys,0), y1=Math.max(...ys,0);
  const xt_=niceTicks(x0,x1,Math.max(3,Math.floor(W/90))), yt_=niceTicks(y0,y1,6);
  x0=Math.min(x0,xt_.ticks[0]); x1=Math.max(x1,xt_.ticks[xt_.ticks.length-1]); y0=Math.min(y0,yt_.ticks[0]); y1=Math.max(y1,yt_.ticks[yt_.ticks.length-1]);
  let tlw=0; yt_.ticks.forEach(t=>tlw=Math.max(tlw,tw(tickFmt(t,yt_.step),12)));
  const ml=14+18+Math.ceil(tlw)+8, mr=10, mt=10, mb=50; const pw=W-ml-mr, ph=H-mt-mb;
  const x=v=>ml+(v-x0)/(x1-x0)*pw, y=v=>mt+ph-(v-y0)/(y1-y0)*ph;
  const svg=el("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,role:"group","aria-label":"Scatter of OPEN home against the B5 residual; use left and right arrow keys to step through points",tabindex:"0"},box);
  xt_.ticks.forEach(t=>{ el("line",{x1:x(t),x2:x(t),y1:mt,y2:mt+ph,stroke:"var(--grid)"},svg); const tt=el("text",{x:x(t),y:mt+ph+17,"font-size":12,"text-anchor":"middle"},svg); tt.textContent=tickFmt(t,xt_.step); });
  yt_.ticks.forEach(t=>{ el("line",{x1:ml,x2:ml+pw,y1:y(t),y2:y(t),stroke:"var(--grid)"},svg); const tt=el("text",{x:ml-8,y:y(t)+4,"font-size":12,"text-anchor":"end"},svg); tt.textContent=tickFmt(t,yt_.step); });
  const xl=el("text",{x:ml+pw/2,y:H-8,"font-size":13,"font-weight":600,"text-anchor":"middle"},svg); xl.textContent="OPEN home (z-score units)";
  const yl=el("text",{x:0,y:0,"font-size":13,"font-weight":600,"text-anchor":"middle",transform:`translate(14,${mt+ph/2}) rotate(-90)`},svg); yl.textContent="Observed minus B5 forecast (fields)";
  el("line",{x1:ml,x2:ml+pw,y1:y(0),y2:y(0),stroke:"var(--ink2)","stroke-dasharray":"5 3","stroke-width":1.3},svg);
  const sorted = xs.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b); const cutv = quantile(sorted, SC.cut/100);
  const gp=el("g",{},svg);
  pts.forEach(r=>{ const c=el("circle",{cx:x(r.OPEN_home),cy:y(r.resid),r:r.i===BR.sel?7:3.6,fill:r.i===BR.sel?"var(--ink)":"var(--accent)","fill-opacity":r.i===BR.sel?1:.5,stroke:r.i===BR.sel?"#fff":"none","stroke-width":2,style:"cursor:pointer"},gp);
    const t=`<b>${esc(r.name)}</b><br>${GRP[r.group]}, ${r.t0}<br>OPEN home ${sgn(r.OPEN_home,2)}; observed ${num(r.O2r_m50,2)}, B5 forecast ${num(r.pred_b5,2)}`;
    c.addEventListener("mouseenter",()=>showTip(c,t)); c.addEventListener("mouseleave",hideTip);
    c.addEventListener("click",()=>{ BR.sel=r.i; showTip(c,t); if(!brFiltered().some(q=>q.i===r.i)){ BR.q=""; BR.g="all"; BR.hurt=false; document.getElementById("br-search").value=""; document.getElementById("br-group").value="all"; document.getElementById("br-hurt").checked=false; }
      brRender(); drawScatter(); }); });
  // quintile means (computed in page)
  for(let k=0;k<5;k++){ const a=quantile(sorted,k/5), b=quantile(sorted,(k+1)/5); const inb=pts.filter(r=>r.OPEN_home>=a&&(k===4?r.OPEN_home<=b:r.OPEN_home<b)); if(!inb.length) continue;
    const m=inb.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.resid,0)/inb.length; const g=el("g",{},svg);
    el("rect",{class:"hit",x:x(a),y:y(m)-8,width:Math.max(4,x(b)-x(a)),height:16,fill:"transparent"},g);
    el("line",{x1:x(a),x2:x(b),y1:y(m),y2:y(m),stroke:"var(--warn)","stroke-width":4,"stroke-linecap":"round"},g);
    bindMark(g, `<b>Fifth ${k+1} of OPEN home</b><br>${inb.length} concepts, OPEN ${num(a,2)} to ${num(b,2)}<br>mean residual ${sgn(m,2)} fields`); }
  el("line",{x1:x(cutv),x2:x(cutv),y1:mt,y2:mt+ph,stroke:"var(--ink)","stroke-width":2.2},svg);
  // keyboard stepping
  const order = pts.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.OPEN_home-b.OPEN_home); let kpos = order.findIndex(r=>r.i===BR.sel);
  svg.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{ if(e.key!=="ArrowRight"&&e.key!=="ArrowLeft") return; e.preventDefault(); kpos = e.key==="ArrowRight"?Math.min(order.length-1,kpos+1):Math.max(0,kpos<0?0:kpos-1);
    const r=order[kpos]; const circ=[...gp.children][pts.indexOf(r)]; showTip(circ, `<b>${esc(r.name)}</b><br>OPEN home ${sgn(r.OPEN_home,2)}; observed minus B5 ${sgn(r.resid,2)}`); });
  svg.addEventListener("blur",hideTip);
  document.getElementById("sc-cut-val").textContent = `${SC.cut}th percentile (OPEN ${sgn(cutv,2)})`;
  const hiG=pts.filter(r=>r.OPEN_home>cutv), loG=pts.filter(r=>r.OPEN_home<=cutv);
  const mean=a=>a.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.resid,0)/a.length, beat=a=>100*a.filter(r=>r.resid>0).length/a.length;
  const rho = spearman(xs, ys);
  document.getElementById("sc-stats").innerHTML = `<div><b>${hiG.length} / ${loG.length}</b><span>concepts above / at or below the cut</span></div><div><b>${hiG.length?sgn(mean(hiG),2):"n/a"} / ${loG.length?sgn(mean(loG),2):"n/a"}</b><span>mean residual, high / low (fields)</span></div><div><b>${hiG.length?beat(hiG).toFixed(0):"n/a"}% / ${loG.length?beat(loG).toFixed(0):"n/a"}%</b><span>beat their B5 forecast, high / low</span></div><div><b>${sgn(rho,3)}</b><span>Spearman, OPEN vs residual (${pts.length} shown)</span></div>`;
  const diff = hiG.length&&loG.length ? mean(hiG)-mean(loG) : NaN;
  document.getElementById("tk-scatter").innerHTML = hiG.length&&loG.length ? `${SC.g==="all"?"Across all home groups":"In "+GRP[SC.g]}, concepts above the cut land ${num(Math.abs(diff),2)} fields ${diff>=0?"further above":"further below"} their B5 forecast than concepts below it. The cloud is wide: the tilt is visible in the group means, not in any single concept.` : "Move the cut so both groups contain concepts.";
}
document.getElementById("sc-group").addEventListener("change",e=>{SC.g=e.target.value;drawScatter();});
document.getElementById("sc-cut").addEventListener("input",e=>{SC.cut=+e.target.value;drawScatter();});
drawScatter(); onResize(drawScatter);

/* =====================================================================
   3c. Ladder
   ===================================================================== */
const BUILD = {OPEN_home:{label:"OPEN home",color:"var(--accent)"},OPEN_sizematch:{label:"OPEN sizematch",color:"#56b4e9"},OPEN_all:{label:"OPEN all",color:"#6b7280"}};
function drawLadder(){
  const on=[...document.querySelectorAll(".ld-b")].filter(c=>c.checked).map(c=>c.value);
  const rungs=["R0","R1","R2","R3","R4","R5"];
  const series=on.map(b=>({name:b,color:BUILD[b].color,values:rungs.map(r=>{ const v=LD.ladder[b][r]; return {v:v.rho,lo:v.ci[0],hi:v.ci[1],label:sgn(v.rho,2),tip:`<b>${BUILD[b].label}, ${r}</b><br>partial Spearman ${sgn(v.rho)} ${ci(v.ci)}<br>n = ${v.n}`}; })}));
  const box=document.getElementById("chart-ladder");
  if(!series.length){ box.innerHTML='<p class="small">Tick at least one build.</p>'; document.getElementById("tk-ladder").textContent="No build selected."; return; }
  drawBars(box, rungs, series, {ylabel:"Partial Spearman ρ", xlabel:"Control rung (more controls to the right)", aria:"Grouped bars of partial Spearman by rung and build", height:320, valueLabels:false});
  document.getElementById("legend-ladder").innerHTML = series.map(s=>`<span><i class="sw" style="background:${s.color}"></i>${BUILD[s.name].label} (n = ${LD.ladder[s.name].R0.n})</span>`).join("")+`<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--ink);width:2px"></i>95% concept-bootstrap CI</span>`;
  const hm=LD.ladder.OPEN_home, c1=LD.contrasts["all_minus_home|R3"], c2=LD.contrasts["sizematch_minus_home|R3"];
  let t="";
  if(on.includes("OPEN_home")) t+=`OPEN<sub>home</sub> falls from ${sgn(hm.R0.rho,2)} at R0 to ${sgn(hm.R5.rho,2)} at R5; its R2 value is ${sgn(hm.R2.rho)} ${ci(hm.R2.ci)}, and ${["R4","R5"].filter(r=>hm[r].ci[0]<=0).length} of the two strictest rungs have CIs that include zero. `;
  if(on.includes("OPEN_all")&&on.includes("OPEN_home")) t+=`OPEN<sub>all</sub> sits above it at every rung; at the footprint rung the gap is ${sgn(c1.diff)} ${ci(c1.ci)}, and about half of it is paper count (size-matched minus home: ${sgn(c2.diff)} ${ci(c2.ci)}).`;
  else if(on.includes("OPEN_all")) t+=`OPEN<sub>all</sub> is the strongest build, and partly mechanically coupled to the outcome.`;
  else if(!on.includes("OPEN_home")) t+=`The size-matched build removes the paper-count part of the coupling.`;
  document.getElementById("tk-ladder").innerHTML=t;
}
document.querySelectorAll(".ld-b").forEach(c=>c.addEventListener("change",drawLadder));
drawLadder(); onResize(drawLadder);

/* =====================================================================
   3d. Retained frontier
   ===================================================================== */
const CRIT = {"1_pooled4_R3":"Pooled held-out d0 at R3 has a CI above zero","2_S_strict":"d0 survives the strict rival set (all four RCA densities and both volume densities)","3_sign_rule":"d0 is positive in the majority of evaluable held-out groups","4_permutation_p<0.05":"Retained-label permutation null is rejected","5_volume_matched_CI>0":"Volume-matched contrast (retained vs entered-but-not-retained fields in the same volume cell) has a CI above zero","6_EXP6_R3_CI>0":"d0 at R3 has a CI above zero on the original frame"};
function drawFrontier(){
  const dev=document.getElementById("fr-dev").checked, fail=document.getElementById("fr-fail").checked;
  const rows=[];
  FR.units.filter(u=>dev||u.kind!=="dev").forEach(u=>rows.push({label:u.label, sub:"n = "+u.n.toLocaleString("en-US"), est:u.est, lo:u.ci[0], hi:u.ci[1], kind:u.kind==="dev"?"sel":"body",
    val:num(u.est)+" "+ci(u.ci,3,false), tip:`<b>${u.label}</b><br>d0 = ${num(u.est)} ${ci(u.ci,3,false)}<br>${u.n.toLocaleString("en-US")} concepts${u.events?"; "+u.events.toLocaleString("en-US")+" entry events":""}${u.kind==="dev"?"<br>Selection data":""}`}));
  rows.push({label:"Held-out pooled, R3", sub:FR.n_events.toLocaleString("en-US")+" entries", est:FR.pooled.est, lo:FR.pooled.ci[0], hi:FR.pooled.ci[1], kind:"body", sep:true, val:num(FR.pooled.est)+" "+ci(FR.pooled.ci,3,false),

auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.9rem}\n@media (max-width:560px){.srow{grid-template-columns:1fr auto}.srow input{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%}}\n.srow rect.bar{transition:opacity .15s}\n}\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<a class=\"skip\" href=\"#main\">Skip to main content</a>\n<header class=\"top\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <p class=\"kicker\">Interactive companion to the paper</p>\n    <h1>Early co-occurrence network openness predicts cross-disciplinary concept breadth: evidence from 12,499 scientific concepts</h1>\n    <p class=\"byline\">AI Inventor</p>\n    <div class=\"links\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_DVtwwCx0JbFq/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_DVtwwCx0JbFq/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_DVtwwCx0JbFq\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</header>\n<nav class=\"sec\" aria-label=\"Sections\">\n  <ul>\n    <li><a href=\"#finding\">The finding</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#method\">How it works</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#explore\">Explore the evidence</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#try\">Try it</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#fails\">Where it fails</a></li>\n    <li><a href=\"#about\">Links and glossary</a></li>\n  </ul>\n</nav>\n<main id=\"main\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"finding\" aria-labelledby=\"h-finding\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-finding\">The finding</h2>\n  <div class=\"grid2\">\n    <div class=\"measure\">\n      <p class=\"lede\">Some new scientific concepts stay inside the field that coined them; others turn up in a dozen fields within a decade. Popularity already predicts much of that difference. The question here is narrower: once early volume, growth and spread are held fixed, does the <em>shape</em> of a concept's early topic neighbourhood say anything more about how broadly it will travel?</p>\n      <p>The answer is a small yes. Concepts whose early <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"home\">home-field</button> <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"cooc\">co-occurrence</button> partners are new and span many topic communities, measured by the <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"OPEN\">OPEN index</button>, later reach more fields per paper (<button class=\"term\" data-term=\"O2r\">rarefied breadth</button>) than the <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"B5\">popularity baseline</button> expects.</p>\n      <div class=\"bignum\" id=\"big-num\"></div>\n      <p class=\"small\" id=\"big-cap\"></p>\n      <p>The association has the same sign in every body of concepts not used to choose the index, but it is weak, it adds almost nothing to forecasting accuracy, and it behaves like a fixed property of a concept's topic mix, not like turnover that happens year by year. The paper calls the evidence state a <em>lead</em>.</p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-headline\" aria-labelledby=\"q-headline\">\n      <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-headline\">Does the association hold in every body of concepts?</p>\n      <p class=\"qsub\">Each row is one body of concepts. The measure is the <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"PSP\">partial Spearman</button> correlation between the index and later breadth after the <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"rung\">control rung</button>. Zero means no information beyond the controls.</p>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <div><span class=\"ctl-label\" id=\"lab-feat\">Index</span>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-feat\" id=\"ctl-feat\"></div></div>\n        <div><span class=\"ctl-label\" id=\"lab-rung\">Controls</span>\n          <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-labelledby=\"lab-rung\" id=\"ctl-rung\"></div></div>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"ctl-dev\"> Show the DEV selection body</label>\n        <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"ctl-band\" checked> Show the placebo null band</label>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"chart-headline\"></div>\n      <div class=\"legend\" id=\"legend-headline\"></div>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tk-headline\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"method\" aria-labelledby=\"h-method\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-method\">How it works: one concept, start to finish</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">The stepper follows one real record from the fresh 2015&ndash;2017 onset cohort, the only body never used in any earlier step. Every value shown is the value the run stored for this concept, or is computed from those values with the frozen constants the run sealed before looking at outcomes.</p>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-stepper\" aria-labelledby=\"q-stepper\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-stepper\">What happens to a concept between its first papers and its breadth score?</p>\n    <p class=\"qsub\" id=\"stepper-concept\"></p>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"chart-pipeline\"></div>\n    <ol class=\"stepper-markers\" id=\"step-markers\" aria-label=\"Stages\"></ol>\n    <div id=\"step-live\" class=\"sr\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    <h3 id=\"step-title\" tabindex=\"-1\"></h3>\n    <div class=\"stage\" id=\"step-body\"></div>\n    <div class=\"navbtns\">\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"step-prev\">Previous stage</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" id=\"step-next\">Next stage</button>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"small\">Left and right arrow keys also move between stages while the stepper has focus.</p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tk-stepper\"></p>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"explore\" aria-labelledby=\"h-explore\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-explore\">Explore the evidence</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">Four views over the stored records. The first two use the 1,443 concepts of the 2015&ndash;2017 cohort one by one; the third shows how the estimate moves as controls are added; the fourth covers the second research question, how concepts pick the next field they enter.</p>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-browser\" aria-labelledby=\"q-browser\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-browser\">What does the index do for one concept?</p>\n    <p class=\"qsub\">Pick a concept to set its early-window inputs beside two frozen predictions of its later breadth: the <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"B5\">B5</button> baseline alone, and B5 plus OPEN<sub>home</sub>. Both models were fitted on the earlier 12,499-concept frame and never refitted on this cohort.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <input type=\"search\" id=\"br-search\" placeholder=\"Search concept name\" aria-label=\"Search concept name\">\n      <select id=\"br-group\" aria-label=\"Home group\"></select>\n      <select id=\"br-sort\" aria-label=\"Sort order\">\n        <option value=\"open_desc\">OPEN<sub>home</sub> high to low</option>\n        <option value=\"open_asc\">OPEN home low to high</option>\n        <option value=\"y_desc\">Breadth high to low</option>\n        <option value=\"gain_desc\">OPEN helped most</option>\n        <option value=\"gain_asc\">OPEN hurt most</option>\n        <option value=\"name\">Name A to Z</option>\n      </select>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"br-scored\" checked> Only concepts with a breadth outcome and an OPEN<sub>home</sub> score</label>\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"br-hurt\"> Only cases where adding OPEN moved the prediction away from the outcome</label>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <div>\n        <p class=\"count\" id=\"br-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n        <div class=\"list\" id=\"br-list\" role=\"listbox\" aria-label=\"Concepts\" tabindex=\"0\"></div>\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"plain-btn\" id=\"br-more\" style=\"margin-top:8px\">Show more</button>\n      </div>\n      <div id=\"br-detail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tk-browser\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-scatter\" aria-labelledby=\"q-scatter\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-scatter\">Do high-OPEN concepts beat their popularity forecast?</p>\n    <p class=\"qsub\">Each point is one cohort concept. Up means the concept reached more fields than the B5 baseline predicted. Drag the cut to split concepts into high and low OPEN<sub>home</sub> and compare how far each group lands above the baseline. Click a point to open it in the browser above.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <select id=\"sc-group\" aria-label=\"Home group for scatter\"></select>\n      <div><label for=\"sc-cut\" class=\"ctl-label\">OPEN<sub>home</sub> cut</label>\n        <input type=\"range\" id=\"sc-cut\" min=\"5\" max=\"95\" step=\"5\" value=\"50\" aria-describedby=\"sc-cut-val\">\n        <span class=\"rangeval\" id=\"sc-cut-val\"></span></div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"chart-scatter\" ></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\">\n      <span><i class=\"sw dot\" style=\"background:var(--accent);opacity:.6\"></i>concept</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw line\"></i>B5 prediction (residual 0)</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--warn);height:4px\"></i>mean residual within each fifth of OPEN<sub>home</sub></span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--ink);width:3px\"></i>cut</span>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"stat\" id=\"sc-stats\"></div>\n    <p class=\"small\">Everything in this view is computed in the page from the stored outcome and the stored B5 prediction. The rank correlation printed here is a plain Spearman correlation with the B5 residual, not the paper's partial Spearman, which residualises on the full control rung.</p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tk-scatter\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-ladder\" aria-labelledby=\"q-ladder\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-ladder\">How much of the signal survives stricter controls, and how much is coupling?</p>\n    <p class=\"qsub\">On the 2015&ndash;2017 cohort the paper runs a six-rung ladder, R0 to R5, each rung adding controls. Three builds of the index are compared: <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"OPENhome\">home only</button>, <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"OPENall\">all papers</button> and <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"OPENsize\">size-matched</button>.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Builds shown\">\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"ld-b\" value=\"OPEN_home\" checked> OPEN<sub>home</sub></label>\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"ld-b\" value=\"OPEN_sizematch\" checked> OPEN<sub>sizematch</sub></label>\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"ld-b\" value=\"OPEN_all\" checked> OPEN<sub>all</sub></label>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"chart-ladder\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\" id=\"legend-ladder\"></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tk-ladder\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-frontier\" aria-labelledby=\"q-frontier\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-frontier\">Do concepts enter fields related to the fields that currently keep them?</p>\n    <p class=\"qsub\">A <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"clogit\">conditional logit</button> on field-entry events, fitted on an independent frame of 11,841 concepts. The coefficient <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"d0\">d<sub>0</sub></button> is the change in log-odds of entering a field per SD of relatedness to the <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"retained\">retaining fields</button>, after home relatedness, field size, entered density, gateway centrality, RCA density and volume density.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"fr-dev\"> Show the DEV selection set</label>\n      <label class=\"chk\"><input type=\"checkbox\" id=\"fr-fail\"> Only the pre-registered criteria that failed</label>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"chart-frontier\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\">\n      <span><i class=\"sw dot\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>unit estimate, 95% concept-bootstrap CI</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--ink);transform:rotate(45deg);width:11px;height:11px\"></i>DerSimonian&ndash;Laird pool of the four held-out groups</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw line\"></i>d<sub>0</sub> = 0</span>\n    </div>\n    <h4 style=\"margin-top:16px\">Pre-registered criteria for the frozen verdict</h4>\n    <ul class=\"crit\" id=\"fr-crit\"></ul>\n    <p class=\"takeaway warn\" id=\"tk-frontier\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-cases\" aria-labelledby=\"q-cases\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-cases\">What does an open neighbourhood look like next to a closed one?</p>\n    <p class=\"qsub\">Seven matched pairs from the breadth-decomposition analysis: in each, two concepts with nearly the same early volume, one high and one low on OPEN<sub>all</sub>. These are illustrations, not evidence.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\"><select id=\"cs-pair\" aria-label=\"Case pair\"></select></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"chart-cases\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\">\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>high-OPEN concept</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>low-OPEN concept</span>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tk-cases\"></p>\n    <figure>\n      <img src=\"figures/fig_case_study_v0.png\" alt=\"Three panels. Left: step lines of off-home fields ever entered and currently retained from onset to eight years later; graphics processing unit rises to 11 entered and 8 retained, vertical-axis wind turbine to 6 entered and 4 retained. Middle: GPU's early topic neighbourhood, 34 topics in 8 colour-coded communities, density 0.30. Right: VAWT's neighbourhood, 12 topics in a single Engineering community, density 0.70.\" width=\"1300\" height=\"558\" loading=\"lazy\">\n      <figcaption>Illustrative matched case-study pair from Experiment 12 (case pair 1 of 7): graphics processing unit (GPU; onset t<sub>0</sub>=2008, high early-neighbourhood openness OPEN) versus vertical-axis wind turbine (VAWT; t<sub>0</sub>=2009, low OPEN). Both have an Engineering home field and are matched on early volume and growth. (a) Number of off-home venue fields each concept has ever entered (solid line, filled markers) and currently retains (dashed line, open markers) in each year from t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+8; GPU is shown in black and VAWT in grey on a shared axis. By t<sub>0</sub>+2 GPU had entered 7 off-home fields and VAWT 2; by t<sub>0</sub>+8 they had entered 11 and 6 and retained 8 and 4. (b, c) Topic co-occurrence ego networks over the first three years (t<sub>0</sub> to t<sub>0</sub>+2, all papers). The nodes are the concept's positive-PMI neighbour topics (the concept itself is not drawn), the edges are links between those topics in the 2010&ndash;14 topic backbone, node area scales with the number of the concept's papers carrying the topic, and colour gives the topic's Leiden community, named by the plurality OpenAlex field of its topics (plus the runner-up field when it has at least 0.6 times as many). GPU's neighbourhood has 34 topics in 8 communities (density 0.30), led by Engineering &amp; Physics, Computer Science and Medicine communities. VAWT's has 12 topics in a single Engineering community (density 0.70). The pair illustrates the openness&ndash;breadth association and is not evidence for it (case_pairs.json, pair 1).</figcaption>\n    </figure>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"try\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Try it: compute OPEN<sub>home</sub> yourself</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">The index is simple enough to run exactly in the page. Each of the six components is clipped to the bounds frozen on the development frame, standardised with the frozen mean and SD, given its sign, and averaged. The two frozen prediction models are linear, so the page reproduces them too. Start from any concept's recorded inputs, then move a component and watch the index and the second prediction respond.</p>\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-try\" aria-labelledby=\"q-try\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-try\">Which components drive a concept's OPEN score, and how far does the score move its forecast?</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <select id=\"try-pick\" aria-label=\"Concept to load\"></select>\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"plain-btn\" id=\"try-load\">Load the concept selected in the browser</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" class=\"plain-btn\" id=\"try-reset\">Reset to recorded values</button>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"grid2\">\n      <div class=\"sliders\" id=\"try-sliders\"></div>\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"chart\" id=\"chart-try\"></div>\n        <div class=\"legend\">\n          <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>signed z raises OPEN</span>\n          <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--warn)\"></i>signed z lowers OPEN</span>\n          <span><i class=\"sw line\"></i>OPEN<sub>home</sub> (mean)</span>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"stat\" id=\"try-stats\"></div>\n    <p class=\"small\" id=\"try-check\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"tk-try\"></p>\n  </div>\n</section>\n\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Where it fails</h2>\n  <p class=\"measure\">Three failures carry the most weight. The forecasting gain is close to zero. The temporal reading of the index, that concepts spread because their partners <em>keep changing</em>, could not be tested. And the field-entry result misses one of its own pre-registered criteria.</p>\n  <div class=\"controls\">\n    <button type=\"button\" class=\"plain-btn\" id=\"goto-hurt\">Show the cohort concepts where OPEN hurt the forecast</button>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\" id=\"v-noise\" aria-labelledby=\"q-noise\">\n    <p class=\"q\" id=\"q-noise\">Is the churn signal real turnover, or a property of small yearly samples?</p>\n    <p class=\"qsub\"><button class=\"term\" data-term=\"NOVCHURN\">NOVCHURN</button> combines neighbourhood novelty and low <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"persist\">edge persistence</button>. Each row rebuilds it under a different noise control, pooled over four bodies at rung R2. Tick a control to add its row.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Noise controls shown\" id=\"nz-ctl\"></div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"chart-noise\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\">\n      <span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>raw NOVCHURN (reference)</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw dot\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>noise-controlled variant, 95% CI</span>\n      <span><i class=\"sw line\"></i>zero</span>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway warn\" id=\"tk-noise\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"view\">\n    <h3>What the paper says it does not show</h3>\n    <ul class=\"measure\">\n      <li><strong>Effect size.</strong> OPEN<sub>home</sub> adds no forecasting gain over B5: <span id=\"lim-gain\"></span> in Spearman on the fresh cohort.</li>\n      <li><strong>Measurement noise.</strong> Split-half reliability of OPEN<sub>home</sub> is 0.49. The temporal-excess variants have split-half reliability below 0.05, so temporal versus static dispersion cannot be resolved at available sample sizes.</li>\n      <li><strong>Vocabulary bias.</strong> The legacy OpenAlex concept vocabulary is survivor-selected. The vocabulary-free Frame N is small (636 concepts), with pre-unseal power of 0.47; its frozen verdict is PARTIAL.</li>\n      <li><strong>Coupling.</strong> About half of the OPEN<sub>all</sub> signal is mechanical coupling between the ego-network construction, which uses off-home papers, and the breadth outcome. OPEN<sub>home</sub> is free of this coupling but marginal.</li>\n      <li><strong>Domain heterogeneity.</strong> Life &amp; Environment shows the weakest OPEN signal in the paper's indicator screen; the retained-frontier coefficient has I<sup>2</sup> = 0.92 across held-out groups.</li>\n      <li><strong>Not causal.</strong> Early openness could reflect a concept's intrinsic generality, the diversity of the research community around it, or the breadth of the problems it addresses. A within-concept closure test is null on DEV and opposite-signed on held-out fields, so openness is a between-concept trait, not a within-concept mechanism.</li>\n      <li><strong>Prior unsealing.</strong> Held-out outcomes were read by two earlier experiments, so all non-selection bodies except the 2015&ndash;2017 cohort are robustness checks, and the six-body pool is descriptive.</li>\n    </ul>\n  </div>\n</section>\n</div>\n</main>\n\n<footer id=\"about\" aria-labelledby=\"h-about\">\n  <div class=\"wrap\">\n    <h2 id=\"h-about\">Links, data and glossary</h2>\n    <div class=\"links\" style=\"margin-bottom:22px\">\n      <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_DVtwwCx0JbFq/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them@fork/run_DVtwwCx0JbFq/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n      <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8795ea-concepts-spread-once-adopters-make-them/tree/fork/run_DVtwwCx0JbFq\">Code repository</a>\n    </div>\n    <h3>Where each view's data comes from</h3>\n    <dl id=\"prov\"></dl>\n    <p class=\"small\" style=\"margin-top:12px\">Every number on this page is read from the embedded files above. I've built `interactive.html` and linked it from `index.html`. I tested it in headless Chromium at 360, 390, 1280 and 1440px wide, using real clicks and taps: every control works, the console shows no errors, the page never scrolls sideways and no chart labels overlap.

**What the page contains**
- **The finding:** the pooled estimate, +0.069 [+0.038, +0.100], shown next to a chart of the result in each of the six bodies of concepts not used to choose the index. Readers can switch the index (OPEN<sub>home</sub> or NOVCHURN<sub>home</sub>), switch the control rung (R0, R2, R3), show or hide the development set used to choose the index, and show or hide the placebo null band. The summary sentence under the chart rewrites itself for each setting.
- **How it works:** a 7-stage stepper that follows one real concept, "Word embedding", from onset through its six raw network measures and their standardisation to OPEN<sub>home</sub>, the two forecasts and its observed breadth. It ends with the cohort result, +0.091 [+0.013, +0.171].
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - a browser over all 1,443 concepts in the 2015–2017 cohort, with search, group filter, sort options and a filter for cases where adding OPEN made the forecast worse. The selected concept's inputs sit beside the popularity-only forecast, the forecast with OPEN added, and what actually happened.
  - a scatter of OPEN against how far each concept beat its popularity forecast, with a slider that splits concepts into high and low OPEN and recomputes the comparison live.
  - the six-rung control ladder for the three versions of the index.
  - the field-entry coefficient d<sub>0</sub> by group, with the six pre-registered criteria marked pass or fail.
  - the seven matched case pairs, plus the paper's GPU vs VAWT figure (the only paper figure used).
- **Try it:** a live OPEN<sub>home</sub> calculator with a slider for each of the six measures. It uses the same clipping, frozen constants and forecast models as the run, and reproduces the stored value for every concept to within 1e-15.
- **Where it fails:** one button jumps to the 263 of 573 concepts where adding OPEN hurt the forecast. A second chart shows the churn signal under different noise controls: it collapses from +0.116 to +0.008 against the within-concept permutation null. The paper's limitations follow.

**Numbers:** every number the paper states appears on the page exactly as the paper states it, taken from the run's output files. The one exception is the field-entry intervals by group. The paper reports two different intervals for the same estimates: its table (for example Physical Sciences [0.078, 0.219]) and its entry figure. Only the figure's intervals can be traced to the output files, so the page shows those (Physical Sciences [0.074, 0.219]), and a footer note says so.

**Other changes:**
- `index.html` got only the "Explore the interactive demo" link, next to the paper link in the hero and in the footer.
- I added one line for `interactive.html` to the Layout list in `README.md`. The instructions said to change nothing else in the folder, but the repository instructions ask for a README line per important file, so remove it if you'd rather keep the README untouched.
- Nothing heavy was added, so the manifest stays empty.

The structured result is in `.terminal_claude_agent_struct_out.json`.
